positions.as_written: Compare the tenderness there with the tenderness at the joint line itself, and record which is greater, because that comparison is the finding.
Ask the patient to flex the knee against resistance and note whether that reproduces the pain, which implicates the hamstring insertion.
Tenderness at both the pes and the joint line means two possible sources, which is common in a degenerative knee and should be recorded as both.
